title: A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A Gothic horror plane where wards and prayers are failing against monsters.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel whose presence once gave hope and belief the power to smite the darkness; she has disappeared.

entities.name: Avacynian Church
entities.description: Church of Avacyn that recruits holy warriors against the monsters.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker hunting the demons to whom she owes her soul, using the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon to whom Liliana owes her soul, now on Innistrad.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker and hunter cursed by Liliana with the Chain Veil and slowly transforming into a monster.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A dark artifact that Liliana exploits and that cursed Garruk.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A cult that summons demons from the deep abysses.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: A crack in the earth that spews forth demons and devils.

entities.name: Elgaud Grounds
entities.description: Place that trains cathars, now reporting fewer recruits.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Monsters terrorizing country hamlets that now return after being slain.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Monsters whose families gain ascendancy in every province.

entities.name: Mysterious returning planeswalker
entities.description: An unnamed planeswalker with a past tied to Innistrad whose return will uncover long-buried secrets.

events.summary: Avacyn disappears; the wards weaken and the Church recruits new holy warriors.
events.quote: Even after Avacyn disappeared and the fiendish creatures of the night advanced, the people of the four provinces survived.

events.summary: Monsters learn humanity's defenses are thin and the slain begin to rise again.
events.quote: Apparently slain werewolves have begun to stagger back to their feet

events.summary: Humans lose hope, topple Avacyn's statues and turn to demonic cults.
events.quote: Demonic cults have gained in membership as people seek some power, any power, on which they can rely.

events.summary: Demons emerge through cults and cracks such as the Ashmouth, using humans for sacrifices.
events.quote: Cracks in the earth, such as the Ashmouth, spew forth demons and devils who spread mayhem and death wherever they go.

events.summary: Liliana Vess learns that Griselbrand is on Innistrad and plans to confront the Church's highest echelons.
events.quote: She has found that the demon Griselbrand is here, on Innistrad

events.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker tracks Liliana to Innistrad while transforming under the Chain Veil's curse.
events.quote: has tracked the death-witch to Innistrad.

relations.note: She owes her soul to demons including Griselbrand.
relations.quote: the powerful demons to whom she owes her soul.

relations.note: Cursed by her, he hunts her.
relations.quote: cursed by Liliana with the power of the Chain Veil
